ns2:section.sectionText: Meets with SOC 199-59898. Topic: Genes and Behavior: From Science to Society. Study some of the latest findings on the subject of how genes influence behavior, and what the societal and ethical implications are. Readings will draw upon articles from the New York Times and the primary literature, with appropriate guidance to students. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to first time freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. MEETS IN 1619 IGB
